data.case_title: Plumber invoice for repair work (Sanitär Beispiel & Söhne)
data.explanation: This is an invoice from a plumbing company for a repair job done at the home on 21 April 2026. The total amount of €208.73 is due within 10 days of the invoice date (22 April 2026), to be paid in full without deduction. When transferring the money, the invoice number should be included as the payment reference so the company can match the payment. No other action is required if the bill is correct.
